What is Black Car Service?

Black car service refers to professional chauffeur-driven transportation using luxury sedans and SUVs. Unlike rideshare:

  • Pre-scheduled - Confirmed reservation, no surge
  • Professional drivers - Trained, suited, discreet
  • Premium vehicles - Mercedes, BMW, Cadillac
  • White-glove service - Door-to-door attention
